snap_answer_local_optin.default_behavior: set_snap_enabled stays false by default, so an answer only carries a=sctp-init when the application opted in; a SNAP-capable peer is then declined and falls back to the regular SCTP handshake, exactly like upstream pion peerconnection.go:3014

opus_nack_primary_retransmit.boundaries: No Cargo or runtime execution performed. Packet/SDP/real encrypted loss-recovery regression source added; Go differential and final-candidate global acceptance remain NOT_RUN. Prior patches unchanged.

keyframe_skip_ahead_after_gap.license: Existing str0m license files retained unchanged
keyframe_skip_ahead_after_gap.upstream_reference: LiveKit v1.13.10 forwards packets without depacketizing hold-back (pkg/sfu/rtpmunger.go keeps SN - snOffset gaps); pion/webrtc-pion v4.2.18-warp.6 has no frame reordering buffer on the SFU path
keyframe_skip_ahead_after_gap.scope: When the depacketizing buffer is blocked by a gap, an incomplete head frame or an expired sequence, drop everything before the first queued segment that starts a VP8/VP9 keyframe and emit it immediately instead of waiting for hold_back (30 frames) or reordering_timeout (2s).
